name: mechanical-smells
title: The habit-hooks findings become a catalog, a viewer-shell program, and the next cluster's program
outcome: The viewer shell has no file over 200 lines, no path over complexity 10, and no duplicate import, and a findings catalog clusters the standing smells so the next program resolves one cluster by name.
done_when: The findings catalog lists every smell, its count, its cluster, and a verdict, and a later design reads it instead of a fresh scan
Re-running habit-sensors on the viewer shell reports zero oversized-file, zero high-complexity, zero duplicate-import, and zero too-many-parameters findings
The oversized-function residual is zero, or each 13-to-30-line residual is one render unit and the sensor card records the exception
The viewer builds with npm run build, its vitest suite passes, and the committed index.html rebuilds byte-identically after the logic epics
The seven section renderers and the atom and hook export names stay stable, proven by the tests that import them
The two React-lint findings clear in the shell, and the shell's non-null assertions clear
The program authors the next cluster's program, type-surface-sweep, as a goal.json, and marks its catalog row commissioned
abort_if: A split must change an export name the tests import, so the shell's public surface cannot stay stable
A logic split changes the rendered output, so npm run build and vitest cannot both stay green
The function-line exception needs a sensor-card change the program does not own

min_work.derived_from: 346 viewer-shell findings in about 40 files, 14 smells across 2,456 findings, 6 clusters, 3 hard limits plus one function-line exception, 4 export surfaces
min_work.note: Decided in chat on 2026-10-24. The program resolves the viewer-shell structural cluster (epics E2 to E5) and ends by commissioning the type-surface cluster (E6). The full reviewer round is pending, so the stage is decided, not approved. The Python structural, duplicate, and comment-habit clusters stay deferred to later programs named in the catalog.

epics.title: The catalog: one findings-catalog.md holds the scan, the 14 smells with counts, the six clusters, and a verdict per cluster. A later design reads it instead of a fresh scan.
epics.outcome: The catalog exists, lists every smell and cluster with a verdict, and the program's epics cite it by cluster name.

epics.title: The logic layer, the tracer bullet: split shell/model.ts, data/bundle.ts, data/works.ts, and data/joins.ts under 200 lines and complexity 10, keeping their export surfaces stable. Pure logic, so the vitest suite proves identical behavior. It proves the split pattern and the export-stability contract.
epics.outcome: The four logic files clear the file and complexity limits, the export names stay stable, and vitest passes.

epics.title: The atoms and sections: split shell/atoms.tsx and shell/sections.tsx and shell/panels/* by render unit, keeping the atom and section export surfaces stable. The seven section renderers and the UI atoms stay importable by their old names.
epics.outcome: atoms.tsx, sections.tsx, and panels/* clear the file limit, their exports stay stable, and the section-renderer tests pass.

epics.title: The change surface: split shell/change/* (levels.ts, sections.tsx, Sheets.tsx, Diff, Frame), shell/DiagramTiles.tsx, and shell/Pager.tsx under the limits, keeping the change-view exports stable and the react-hooks finding in DiagramTiles.tsx clear.
epics.outcome: The change-surface files clear the file and complexity limits and the react-hooks finding clears, with the change tests passing.

epics.title: The top-level shell and chrome: split shell/App.tsx, shell/Sheet.tsx, shell/WorkDrawer.tsx, shell/Rail.tsx, shell/TopBar.tsx, components/ui/sidebar.tsx, shell/hooks.ts, and the long tail. Clear the shell's 37 duplicate-imports, 2 non-null assertions, and 4 too-many-parameters, and the jsx-a11y finding. The final habit-sensors pass on the shell reports zero structural findings.
epics.outcome: The shell clears every structural, import, and React-lint finding, the ShellApp export stays stable, and the full viewer suite passes.

epics.title: Commission the next cluster: decide the type-surface cluster (explicit-any, non-null-assertion outside the shell) as the next program and author type-surface-sweep/goal.json for it. Mark its catalog row commissioned, and record the duplicate, Python-exception, and comment-habit clusters as the following candidates.
epics.outcome: The type-surface-sweep program exists as a goal.json, its catalog row is commissioned, and the three deferred clusters are named as candidates.
